title: 98.css
summary: 98.css is a CSS library that enables developers to style modern web applications with the nostalgic Windows 98 user interface aesthetic, using only CSS without any images or external assets.
problem_solved: Provides a lightweight solution for creating authentic Windows 98-style UI designs without requiring image assets or complex setup
why_valuable: Offers nostalgic appeal for retro computing enthusiasts while serving educational purposes and enabling unique creative design projects with minimal dependencies
